title: Revealment
statement: Let a randomized decision tree have a finite alphabet, and let $\pi$ be a probability distribution on that alphabet. Its revealment is the largest probability, over the $n$ coordinates, that the tree queries that coordinate, with revealment defined to be $0$ when there are no coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability distribution on the alphabet.
